_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for API stats shown across the marketing site. To change the endpoint count, edit endpointCount HERE ONLY — scripts/inject-stats.mjs replaces every %%ENDPOINT_COUNT%% token in the built dist/ at build time, so no page hardcodes it. Derive the number from the live spec: curl -s https://api.ollagraph.com/openapi.json | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>console.log(Object.values(JSON.parse(s).paths).reduce((n,p)=>n+Object.keys(p).filter(m=>['get','post','put','patch','delete'].includes(m)).length,0)))"
